promotion_rule: A row is linked only when every declared series has a non-missing current observation. A future strategy target or an indicator awaiting its first survey remains partial.
non_goals: Do not convert current observations into policy-achievement judgments.
Do not attach legacy Shorai Vision Osaka series to the new strategy automatically.
Do not infer business-list causality from indicator identity.
Do not rank Osaka against other prefectures before comparability is verified.
